label: CPU
meaning: Mean CPU use over the window. 1 millicore = 1 ms of CPU time per second.

label: CPU time
meaning: Same as CPU, per minute.

label: User-mode share of CPU
meaning: Remainder is kernel time (syscalls, page faults, network stack).

label: CPU cycles
meaning: CPU work independent of clock frequency.

label: Instructions retired
meaning: Instructions executed by the watcher's threads.

label: Instructions per cycle
meaning: Low IPC in idle code usually means cold caches after each wakeup.

label: Effective clock while running
meaning: Clock rate the watcher's own work actually ran at. Shows the CPU frequency policy's effect.

label: Thread wakeups
meaning: How often any thread of the process was put on a CPU.

label: Voluntary context switches (main thread only)
meaning: Main thread only, so not comparable across runtimes: Go's main thread parks while other threads do the work. Use Thread wakeups for the whole process.

label: Involuntary context switches (main thread only)
meaning: Main thread only, as above. Preemptions, mostly noise from other work on the node.

label: Run-queue wait
meaning: Time runnable but waiting for a CPU. A noise indicator, not the watcher's cost.

label: Sample intervals with any CPU use
meaning: Duty cycle at the sampler's resolution (default 100 ms).

label: Activity bursts
meaning: Transitions from an idle tick to an active tick.

label: Page faults
meaning: Memory being touched for the first time, or returned to the kernel and touched again.

label: Anonymous memory
meaning: Heap and stacks.

label: Anonymous memory trend
meaning: Drift within the window. Near 0 means the window is stationary.

label: Resident set size
meaning: Includes the mapped binary and shared libraries.

label: memory.current
meaning: What the kubelet and the OOM killer account against the limit.

label: OS threads
meaning: Kernel threads in the process.

label: Threads that woke
meaning: Distinct OS threads that were scheduled at least once in the window.

label: Wakeups on the busiest thread
meaning: Share of all wakeups taken by the single most active thread.

label: Network packets received
meaning: API server traffic: watch events, bookmarks, TCP ACKs, keepalives.

label: CFS throttled time
meaning: Should be 0.

label: Node load1 max
meaning: Noise check.
